style: Hand-painted gouache and ink fantasy illustration with uneven brown-black dip-pen outlines (never pure black), visible brush texture and painted matte-painting depth, in the manner of an illuminated manuscript brought to full scenes; full-bleed, no border, unsigned. One warm light source per image, most often a single golden sunbeam through a tall arched window. Temple palette of honey gold, sage green and walnut brown with moon-silver sand; inside the sand book, moon silver, ochre and bruise-purple vines on grained vellum. Materials: vellum, cracked leather, verdigris brass, pouring sand.

images.title: The Reader Who Stayed
images.prompt: Hand-painted gouache and ink fantasy illustration, uneven brown-black pen outlines, visible brush texture, matte-painting depth, full-bleed, no border, unsigned. Seen from across a vast ancient library temple hall, small in the upper middle, a very tall, slender adult elf keeper with pale sea-froth green skin, pointed ears, amber eyes and long black hair, in a plain floor-length sage green robe, sits motionless in a worn high-backed reading chair, an ochre leather book open on his lap, a full teacup in his hand, head bowed into the page; nobody else is there. The single golden sunbeam from the tall arched window has drawn back and stops on the floor short of the chair. Silver sand drifts round the chair legs. On a shelf behind him a black-bound book lets one thin thread of pale mist out from under its cover. A stopped cuckoo clock on a pillar. The lower quarter is empty shadowed stone floor. Dulled honey gold, sage green, walnut, moon silver, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo

images.title: The Rider
images.prompt: Hand-painted gouache and ink fantasy illustration, uneven brown-black pen outlines, visible brush texture, matte-painting depth, full-bleed, no border, unsigned. A storybook plate on grained vellum. A high, rising view over a moonlit sea of silver sand dunes shaped like slow breaking waves, bruise-purple vines in the troughs. Far off in the upper right, tiny and seen from behind, a boy of about fourteen in a faded ochre head-cloth with a patched pack rides the long scaled back of a huge wet-sand-coloured beast, only the ridge of its back showing above the dunes like a whale's. Ahead of them the painting simply stops: the dunes thin into bare, unpainted white paper. In the left foreground, left behind, a weathered marker pole in a ring of stones with a faded strip of cloth. Cold full-moon light. Moon silver, ochre, bruise purple, vellum white. The lower quarter is smooth empty sand, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo
images.needs_review: Kept the first of two tries. The marker pole and its cloth carry pseudo-lettering marks, and most of the plate is unpainted white rather than moonlit silver. The retry (job a0e83c89-e59a-445a-918a-ab0b9a61321f, not kept) had no lettering but drew the marker as a cross, added a white border and got the beast wrong.

images.title: The Named Book
images.prompt: Hand-painted gouache and ink fantasy illustration, uneven brown-black pen outlines, visible brush texture, matte-painting depth, full-bleed, no border, unsigned. In a vast ancient library temple, a very tall, slender adult elf keeper with pale sea-froth green skin, pointed ears, amber eyes and long black hair, in a plain floor-length sage green robe, stands in profile at a walnut bookshelf on the right and slides a worn ochre leather book into place beside other books; the spine carries a small panel of fresh gold tooling, abstract ornament only. images.title: The Unread Page
images.prompt: Hand-painted gouache and ink fantasy illustration, uneven brown-black pen outlines, visible brush texture, matte-painting depth, full-bleed, no border, unsigned. A quiet still life in a vast, deserted ancient library temple: an empty room, no people, no figure, no legs, no silhouette, nobody. Seen from a few steps back, on a heavy walnut reading table in the upper middle of the frame lies a closed, worn ochre leather book with a blank spine, its brass clasp shut; a single large woody leaf, shaped like a long animal ear, has slipped half out from between its pages. A thin scatter of silver sand around it, long settled. Beside the book an empty teacup with a dry stain ring. An unoccupied worn high-backed upholstered reading chair stands pushed back from the table, its seat bare; behind it only walnut bookshelves. One golden sunbeam from a tall arched window lies across the wood and the closed cover. The lower quarter is the plain dark front of the table and shadowed stone floor. Honey gold, sage green, walnut brown, moon silver. Cracked leather, brass, vellum, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo
